issues.where: MON, NOV 2 · 9:00 AM and MON, NOV 2 · 10:30 AM
issues.quote: Town of Telluride · Town of Telluride /Special Meeting - Planning & Zoning Commission Chair
issues.problem: The same P&Z Chair meeting is listed twice with identical descriptions but different times (9:00 AM and 10:30 AM). One of the two listings is a duplicate and should be removed.
issues.suggestion: Remove one of the two listings, keeping whichever time is correct.
issues.note: Real error. The 9:00 AM agenda only continues the item to 10:30 AM. Fixed for future renders in content-refresh.js (keep the later same-day slot, clean the '/Special' title). This frozen draft still shows both cards. John's Oct 31 draft (014dbbb3) has the single 10:30 card; see review-followup.md.

issues.where: TUE, NOV 3 · 3:00 PM · Medical Center Regular Board Meeting
issues.quote: A short special meeting — just 30 minutes on the books
issues.problem: The section tag and intro both call this a 'Regular Board Meeting,' but the body describes it as a special meeting. These are contradictory; it cannot be both.
issues.suggestion: Reconcile the title and body — if it is a special meeting, change the tag and intro reference to 'Special Meeting'; if it is a regular meeting, remove 'special' from the body.
issues.note: Real error: tellmed.org lists Nov 3 as a Special Meeting (agenda 'THD Special Bd Mtg'). Fixed for future renders in weekly-email.js (Regular -> Special for flagged specials). This draft and the pinned intro in data/week-ahead-lede.json still say 'Regular'; see review-followup.md.

issues.problem: The intro says the Board of Education work session is to 'interview board candidates,' but the body specifies they are interviewing student candidates for the Student Representative seat — a materially different thing.
issues.suggestion: Change the intro to read 'interview student candidates for the Student Representative seat' or similar.

fix.replace: interview student candidates for the Student Representative seat

issues.where: What to Attend · THU, NOV 5 · Facing the Mourning
issues.quote: a free, four-week grief support series taking place every Thursday throughout September
issues.problem: The event is listed under November 5 but the description says it takes place 'throughout September,' contradicting the November date.
issues.suggestion: Update the description to reflect the correct month (November) rather than September.

fix.find: taking place every Thursday throughout September
fix.replace: taking place every Thursday throughout November

issues.quote: second in size only to Kaiser Permanente
issues.problem: CommonSpirit Health is generally ranked second among nonprofit hospital systems by number of hospitals, but Kaiser Permanente is an integrated insurer/provider, not a comparable hospital network. The standard comparison is to HCA Healthcare (for-profit) or, among nonprofits, to Ascension. This claim is misleading.
issues.suggestion: Remove or correct the size comparison; for example, describe CommonSpirit as 'one of the largest nonprofit hospital systems in the country' without the Kaiser comparison.

fix.find: second in size only to Kaiser Permanente
fix.replace: one of the largest nonprofit hospital systems in the country
